lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The mother of a man who was fatally shot by police during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago told a coroner’s inquest Thursday she believes anti-Black racism played a role in her son’s death, The Canadian Press reports.
Why is Italy angry with Ukraine for striking Russian ships off Libya?, Al Jazeera reports.
Iran denies responsibility for attack on Kuwait that killed two Italians, Middle East Eye reports.
French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
